newsitem.title: HONG KONG: No interest in Canada tunnel - Henderson.
newsitem.headline: No interest in Canada tunnel - Henderson.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd on Thursday denied reports in Canadian newspapers it had an interest in financing construction of a C$600 million traffic tunnel under Vancouver's inner harbour.
"This is totally without basis. We are not interested," a company spokesman told Reuters.

The Vancouver Sun and Province newspapers reported on Wednesday the company -- headed by chairman Lee Shau Kee, Hong Kong's richest man -- had approached the local park board about financing the tunnel under the city's Stanley Park.
"Neither the company nor Mr Lee Shau Kee has any interest in the project," the spokesman said.
The company's Canadian affiliate Henderson Development (Canada) Ltd was not involved either, he said.
"I've checked with my colleagues there -- they have not expressed interest," the spokesman said.
The newspapers reported the government of the province of British Columbia would contribute about C$200 million to the project, with Lee putting up the rest.
Lee would then recover his investment through tunnel tolls, they said.
